verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an observability platform with a public API could version it and publish a deprecation policy. The evidence pack documents neither API versioning nor a deprecation policy. An OpenAPI spec is reachable, but that only shows an API exists, not a versioning or deprecation commitment. One user also reports a Grafana Cloud upgrade that broke dashboards and came with no breaking-change documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
